name: context-mcp
description: Load authorized Pyrito Mind context, invoke configured Agents, and explicitly capture useful session outcomes.

interface.shortDescription: Use authorized Pyrito Mind context in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex directly to Pyrito's authenticated Context MCP. Teammates can explicitly load bounded MemoryKnowledge and MemoryCore context, adopt their configured Pyrito Mind Agents, and save concise session outcomes without routing model prompts or responses through Pyrito.
defaultPrompt: Use $prepare-context to load relevant Pyrito context.
Use $invoke-agent to adopt one of my Pyrito Agents.
Use $capture-session to save this session's outcomes.
